title: Chimney not swept in the last year

mitigation.action: Chimney sweep cleans the flue and checks the fireplace and the flue for cracks

known_quirks: Finnish law requires a sweep once a year for a flue in regular use
Soot fires crack masonry flues and ignite the roof structure next to them
Burn only dry wood and a suitable amount (Kunnon Koti autumn to-do)
why_hint: DRAFT: The house has a wood sauna stove or wood, pellet or oil heating, and there is no chimney sweep on record from the last year. The law requires a yearly sweep.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: A yearly sweep prevents soot fires, the common cause of chimney and roof fires in heated homes.
